summary: Ripen Gadget Lifecycle Engine - Full testing complete. All Ripen APIs working correctly. Frontend integration with sidebar, gadget pages, and Settings > Gadgets working after bug fix.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - ReferenceError: plugin is not defined when clicking Installed tab
ui_bugs.fix_applied: Added missing JSX braces around plugins.map() call on line 573

sidebar_gadget_entries.details: Sidebar dynamically shows Games, Photos, Radio, Podcasts entries when gadgets are installed and active

pages_tested: /games - Games page loads with Add ROM Library button
/photos - Photos page loads with Add Library button
/radio - Radio page shows 8 station cards, genre filters (Lo-Fi, Jazz, etc.), search bar
/podcasts - Podcasts page loads with RSS feed subscription UI

settings_gadgets.details: Browse Catalogue tab shows 16 categories with 45 gadgets. Installed tab shows Catalogue Gadgets (3) with toggle/delete and Custom Gadgets (2).

install_button_status.details: Gadgets show 'Get' button when not installed, 'Installed' (green) when installed

about_page_version.details: About page shows WatchNexus v2.5.6 (Latest) with correct changelog: 'Gadgets Catalogue & Library Overhaul'

seed_data_creation: Pre-installed gadgets via curl: wn-arcade-retroarch (Games), wn-gallery-viewer (Photos), wn-cadence-radio (Radio). Additional install during test: wn-rhythm-podcast (Podcasts)
